claim: A June 2018 White House reorganization plan proposed converting the Postal Service into a private company. The Office of Management and Budget report "Delivering Government Solutions in the 21st Century" carried a section titled "Restructure the Postal Service" recommending the agency be prepared for "future conversion from a Government agency into a privately-held corporation," and discussed doing it through an initial public offering or a sale to another entity. The plan was not enacted; the Postal Service remains a federal agency.

sources.label: Office of Management and Budget, "Delivering Government Solutions in the 21st Century: Reform Plan and Reorganization Recommendations" (June 2018), "Restructure the Postal Service"
sources.quote: This proposal would restructure the United States Postal System to return it to a sustainable business model or prepare it for future conversion from a Government agency into a privately-held corporation.
